nodes.label: Declarative Attention (Language Models Can Control Their Own Attention)
nodes.author: Namgyu Ho; Huzama Ahmad; Woosung Koh; Se-Young Yun; Tal Schuster; Cicero Nogueira dos Santos
nodes.rationale: If a model already knows which context parts are relevant, have it declare so in its own chain-of-thought and read those declarations as tool calls to build a real hardware-level KV cache mask, with no training or auxiliary scorer needed.

nodes.label: DA state machine / KV block-table masking
